reviews.text:
Our cats love the Royal Canin Indoor! The feeding guide on the back of the bag is very clear and easy to follow, especially if your cat needs to go on a slight diet - the instructions make it easy to know how much to feed if they are slightly over their ideal weight. 
The biscuits are the perfect size for our automatic feeder, and we haven’t had an issue with hairballs. It is also great to know that my cats are receiving everything they need in their diet for their indoor lifestyle. 

Based on how much my cats love this, it would be criminal for me to ever switch to anything other than Royal Canin. The big bags also make it really easy to stock up!

reviews.title: Kibble connaisseurs
reviews.text:
oyal Canin Indoor Cat Dry Food has been a really positive change for my two indoor cats. One of my boys especially struggled with digestion before, but since switching to this food there are no more runny poos — and no more mess stuck in his fluffy fur, which has been a huge relief. Their digestion is clearly much better overall.

I’ve also noticed that it helps slow down and regulate their energy levels. They seem more settled and content throughout the day, which is great for indoor cats.

The only downside is the kibble size or texture. My two cats (brothers) tend to bite the pieces in half and leave broken bits scattered outside the bowl. This was never an issue when they were on Royal Canin Kitten dry food, so it can get a bit messy.

Overall, it’s a great quality food with clear digestive and behavioural benefits — just wish the kibble design didn’t lead to so much mess.
